name: neo-core
description: Neo core — a coordinated crew of agents: a business-engineer orchestrator that drives a PRD through the Specification loop, spawns one session per task, and walks the Business Engineer through each feature's verification; a technical-engineer orchestrator that drives a task to a validated draft PR via researcher, implementation-planner, code-writer, code-reviewer, and validator; a platform-engineer and an sre that carry a verified feature through release, production, and KPI settlement without ever changing production themselves; plus the feature-agent and task-planner specification crew and their authoring skills, with lifecycle-logging hooks. GitHub Copilot CLI manifest.
